independent_derivation_or_calculation: Using the principle of superposition. The MOI of a full disc of radius R and mass M_full is 1/2 M_full R^2. The cavity of radius R/2 at distance R/2 has mass M_cav = M_full/4. MOI of cavity about its own CM is 1/2 M_cav (R/2)^2 = 1/32 M_full R^2. By parallel axis theorem, its MOI about disc center is I_cav_cm + M_cav (R/2)^2 = 1/32 M_full R^2 + 1/16 M_full R^2 = 3/32 M_full R^2. The remaining MOI is I_full - I_cavity_about_O = 1/2 - 3/32 = 13/32 M_full R^2. If expressed in terms of remaining mass M = 3/4 M_full, then I = 13/24 M R^2.
findings: First-principles derivation matched claimed theorem exactly.
